description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rate of Exchange effective from 10.04.2017 to 16.04.2017
categorisation: This gazette content is a Customs Notification that establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges. It exercises regulatory authority under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235), which falls under legal/regulatory matters. The content involves setting official exchange rates for calculating customs duties, which is a regulatory function rather than a government personnel, organizational, or specialized administrative matter.
